title: Ah! signor, signor!
subtitle: Finale of Act 2 (No. 15), section 4: Antonio and the broken carnations

facts.key: F major (Allegro molto), then B flat major (Andante)
facts.tempo: Allegro molto at ♩ = 160, then Andante at ♩ = 66 (about 6 minutes)

note: Antonio storms in: someone jumped from the window onto his carnations
about: Score: the fourth section of the Act 2 Finale, No. 15, from Antonio's entrance “Ah! signor, signor!” through the Andante in 6/8 (vocal score pages 169-186, 230 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
